files.description: 7-page PDF documenting the Compulink Advantage EHI (PHI) export for 170.315(b)(10). Describes the export format (CSV files + images in password-protected ZIP), file naming conventions, table relationship structure, and FLD field description files. Contains 2 pages of technical content, 2 pages of legal terms, and 3 pages of cover/TOC/blank. Does NOT contain a data dictionary, table listing, field definitions, or sample data — those are deferred to FLD files generated with each export.
